STYLE GUIDE (apply to every asset):
Top-down 3/4 perspective pixel art for a 2D mystery/investigation game, readable dark atmospheric Victorian-industrial pixel art. Strict 16x16 tile grid. Overworld characters 16x32 pixels per frame. Crisp hard pixel edges, no antialiasing, no blur, no gradients. 1px deep blue-grey #1a1c2c outline. Muted max 32 color palette, slate, fog grey, rust, brass, desaturated wool. Flat lighting from upper left. Melancholic, never gory. Actual transparent background, no text, no numbers, no labels, no watermark. No 3D, no photorealism, no chibi or anime.
Asset: exactly ONE complete walking animation sprite sheet. Logical size 64x128 pixels, optionally scaled up by integer nearest-neighbor. Four equal rows and four equal columns (16 cells total). Every cell is 16x32 logical pixels. Rows in order: facing DOWN toward viewer, LEFT profile, RIGHT profile, UP back view. Columns walk cycle: left foot forward, passing feet, right foot forward, passing feet. Real distinct leg and arm motion, preserve same clothing and identity. Feet baseline at logical y=30 of every cell. Full body fits strictly inside its cell, transparent margins, no cropping or overlap. Do not draw a grid.
Character: Maud Keel, weathered female pawnbroker in her fifties, teal-grey wool coat #4e7484, dark knit cap #2a3440, pale knitted scarf #c9c2ad, skin #d8b89a, grey hair #8a8e96 pinned back, legs #2a3440. Jeweller loupe on neck cord, small ring tray at hip. Shrewd, unhurried, slightly stooped. Rounded woman silhouette, not square box. This is a new unique drawing, not a recolor.
sources.processing: equal-grid crop; alpha threshold 128; common per-sheet scale; nearest-neighbor; feet baseline; nearest shared palette with Noll green-cloth anchor normalization; two-frame battle anticipation hold

STYLE GUIDE (apply to every asset):
Top-down 3/4 perspective pixel art for a 2D mystery/investigation game, in the readable, cozy-clean style of classic farming/life-sim pixel games, but dark and atmospheric.
Setting: an original foggy Victorian-era industrial world with occult undertones: cobblestone streets, gas lamps, soot-stained brick, wrought iron, canals, chapels, secret societies, alchemical potions.
Grid: strict 16x16 pixel tiles. Overworld characters are 16x32 pixels per frame. Every pixel must align to the grid; no half pixels, no sub-pixel detail.

Palette: limited muted palette of max 32 colors, matching the existing game sprites. Desaturated slate blues, fog greys, soot browns, mossy greens, rust and brass, bone white; warm amber/yellow only for gas lamp light and candles; turquoise #6fe0d0 or deep violet reserved for occult/supernatural things. Avoid saturated primaries and pure black/white.
Lighting: flat base colors with 2-3 shade steps; light from top-left. Do not bake night darkness into sprites (the engine adds lighting).
Mood: melancholic, mysterious, slightly unsettling, never gory.
Output: transparent background (PNG with alpha) unless stated otherwise, orthographic, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature.
Avoid: 3D render look, painterly style, photorealism, chibi exaggeration, anime eyes, references to existing games, films or franchises.
